title: label-write --land: refuse a `!` or (narrowing) PR whose os-dev-report says dogfood_battery n/a or not run
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Filing-gate category: ① process defect, measured. `reach:` the #31518 7-day re-reading of every merge-queue root, 2026-11-09..15 (comment 6904236520, class (b)). Parent card #31518 (p1, `domain:devx`), Wanted 2 for class (b).

## What happened

Class (b), not selected on the PR, had 6 roots and 18 cascades in the window, the highest cost per root (3.0 cascades). All six are dogfood, which skips `pull_request` by the ruled two-speed design (6663883327 on #30461). That design leans on the os-dev rule that a `!` or (narrowing) PR runs the full dogfood battery before landing, and on `review-checklist.md` line 48 (「`!` 或 `(narrowing)`:入队前核 `dogfood_battery` 钉 head、全量…缺或收窄 ⇒ REWORK」).

Two of the six roots carried `!` in their PR titles, and the battery did not run on the landed head:

- PR #32926 `fix(runtime)!: …` (card #32936): the os-dev-report 6846244737 says `dogfood_battery: "n/a: no ! in the PR title and no (narrowing) arm"`.
- PR #33431 `feat(service-automation)!: …` (card #31699): the last three reports (6869754560, 6878937714, 6879908528) say `"not run: the title carries no breaking marker"`, after earlier rounds had run it.

So the rule exists and was not applied at ACCEPT; the report's own line contradicts the PR's title.

## Ask (`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` `--land`, or the readiness check it already calls)

1. On `--land`, read the PR title. If it carries `!` before the colon or a `(narrowing)` arm, read the newest `os-dev-report` on the PR's card and refuse to land unless its `dogfood_battery` names a head equal to the PR's current head (or an ancestor that differs only by `main` merges, as review-checklist allows).
2. The refusal names the title, the report comment id and its `dogfood_battery` text.
3. Self-test rows for: `!` title with an `n/a` line (refused), `!` title with a run line on the head (passes), no `!` (not judged).

⛔ No change to the two-speed CI design, no dogfood shard added to `pull_request`.

Reader: `domain:skills` lane seat, from `pm:queue` (scripts/pm tooling). Dedupe: `dogfood_battery land refuse`, `breaking marker battery not run`, no open hit. Priority p2: it would have stopped 2 roots and their cascades this week, at no runner cost.
